name: Legible Inc.
summary: Legible Media Inc. is a digital media and entertainment enterprise primarily focused on books. The company offers a subscription-driven digital reading platform, available across browsers and mobile devices. This service acts as a central hub for the distribution of books and audiobooks, catering to publishers, eBook developers, authors, and individual readers alike. The entity previously conducted business as Twenty20 Investment Inc. Legible Media Inc. maintains its headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.
